reeis_preferred.breakdownNote: 1993–2001 CRIS Table H reports CSREES expenditures; 2002 onward combines REEIS formula expenditure reports with nonformula grant obligations, so the 2002 change is an accounting and source break. Capacity groups Hatch, McIntire–Stennis, Evans–Allen and animal health historically; later it uses the reported formula/capacity category. Other grants and agreements groups historical grants and agreements or special grants with other CSREES, and later Smith-Lever 3(d), special grants and other NIFA grants. Categories are broad and may change in coverage. The 2021 estimate combines current grants with archived formula funding.
